properties.name: Palermo Chico
properties.source: Google Maps neighborhood boundary for "Palermo Chico" (viewed 2026-11-06), traced against real street/rail geometry
properties.methodology: Google Maps draws an actual polygon for this one place (unlike the other three): Av. Casares / FC San Martín rail / Austria / Av. del Libertador. Austria does not reach the railway near here (their real crossing is several blocks south, near Canal Siete), so the NE corner is not a street×street intersection: it is Austria's own northernmost mapped point (a real OSM coordinate, ~70m from where the rail passes closest to it) rather than an invented one. The other three corners are real intersections: Av. Casares × FC San Martín rail (NW), Av. Casares × Av. del Libertador (SW), Austria × Av. del Libertador (SE).

properties.name: Palermo Soho
properties.source: Mudafy.com.ar / roomix.ai real-estate guides: "entre las avenidas Scalabrini Ortiz, Córdoba, Juan B. Justo y Santa Fe"
properties.methodology: Quadrilateral from the real intersections of these four streets: Av. Juan B. Justo (shared edge with Palermo Hollywood to its north) and Av. Scalabrini Ortiz as the cross sides; Av. Santa Fe and Av. Córdoba as the long sides.

properties.name: Palermo Hollywood
properties.source: roomix.ai / Billiken: "entre Juan B. Justo, Córdoba, Dorrego y Santa Fe"
properties.methodology: Quadrilateral from the real intersections of these four streets: Av. Juan B. Justo (shared edge with Palermo Soho to its south) and Av. Dorrego as the cross sides; Av. Santa Fe and Av. Córdoba as the long sides.

properties.name: Las Cañitas
properties.source: roomix.ai: "delimitado por las avenidas Luis María Campos, Dorrego y Del Libertador y la calle Matienzo"
properties.methodology: Quadrilateral from the real intersections of these four streets: Av. del Libertador and Av. Luis María Campos as the long (roughly parallel) sides; Matienzo and Av. Dorrego as the cross sides.
